instrumentation: Read-only entry hooks log accessor order without replacing instructions. All lookup, accessor and comparator bodies execute unchanged.
boundaries: Projected valid global type and registry bucket arrays; name bytes encode Latin1 with C NUL termination.
Native type==count executes indexed lookup. Tests allocate the extra readable slot; an absent slot is an unsafe original read, not an invented null result.
Negative counts and record counts preserved. Invalid pointers, concurrent registry mutation and arbitrary callback side effects excluded.
